profiles.proposed_method: Verify pressure-thrust identities; assess matched-hardware ambient-pressure predictions before fitting any residual.
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: No reviewed same-hardware multi-ambient measurement matrix.

profiles.proposed_method: Analytic solids, Boolean/topology checks, neutral-file round trips and inspection; no learned physics.
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: As-built metrology and geometry identity must be assessed separately from software geometry.

profiles.proposed_method: Verify geometry/volume identities; assess a separate source-specific combustion-efficiency model when losses are identifiable.
profiles.observables_or_checks: chamber pressure, mass flow, throat geometry, cstar efficiency
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: No generic L-star or shoulder-fill performance law established by this collection.

profiles.proposed_method: Reproduce a measured source case, then assess bounded pressure/performance-loss residuals.
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: Boundary-layer displacement is not uniquely identified by wall-pressure observations alone.

profiles.proposed_method: Separate hydraulic flow fitting, atomization and combustion targets; distinct geometry and propellant families.
profiles.observables_or_checks: flow, Cd, geometry, spray, cstar efficiency, time histories
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: No actual conical-seat-valve pilot measurement CSVs supplied; source papers are not a transferable exact-part Cd curve.

profiles.proposed_method: Verify algebraic bolt/plate screens; later assess against measured loads/preload/strain/leakage and FEA.
Fit/interpolate temperature-dependent coupon properties with process and test mode retained.
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: As-built process variability and thermomechanical life not established.

profiles.proposed_method: Verify contour mathematics and numerical reference behavior; compare measured wall pressure/thrust before fitting bounded loss corrections.
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: Cuffel paper acquired from a third-party host; full profile not yet digitized; current anchors are rounded; reacting/viscous/shocked regimes need distinct assessment.

profiles.proposed_method: Keep ideal identities fixed; assess delivered-performance loss components and observation uncertainty.
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: Do not absorb several unidentifiable component losses into one efficiency.

profiles.proposed_method: Source-specific head/efficiency/NPSH maps with uncertainty, then justified speed-transfer comparisons.
profiles.observables_or_checks: flow, speed, head, torque, power, inlet state, NPSH
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: Cryogenic and new-geometry transfer unestablished; no motor/inverter/battery maps or exact-part casing-joint data acquired.

profiles.proposed_method: Locate original measurement campaigns behind reviews, then assess a source-specific onset model.
profiles.observables_or_checks: separation location and onset versus chamber/ambient state
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: No new numeric onset extraction; do not infer side-load prediction or reuse shared campaigns as independent tests.

profiles.proposed_method: Component target comparisons, then regime-specific residuals or assessed VOF/parcel models.
profiles.observables_or_checks: spray angle, sheet dimensions, SMD, distribution at defined planes
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: Missing carrier fields, stochastic tracking inputs, raw droplet observations and limited independent campaigns block end-to-end validation.

profiles.proposed_method: Verify elastic screens; assess FEA and fit compatible constitutive/fatigue response separately.
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: Coupon data do not establish chamber ratcheting, creep or thermomechanical life.

profiles.proposed_method: Separate gas heating, coolant HTC, friction and thermal response; fit identifiable correction terms, then consider CHT fusion.
profiles.observables_or_checks: heat input, located wall temperature, coolant state, pressure loss
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: Mixed fluids/regimes and inverse/model-reduced observables; no universal heat-transfer, CHF or radiation calibration from these sources.

profiles.proposed_method: Numerical solver/reference verification with held-out states; physical delivered-performance assessment is a separate task.
profiles.observables_or_checks: thermochemical reference states, cstar with independent loss accounting
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: Measured cstar efficiency does not isolate equilibrium-chemistry error.

profiles.proposed_method: Verify start-line equations, then compare resolved measured pressure and discharge for matching geometry.
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: Full paper acquired from a third-party host; only two rounded anchors presently numeric; no reviewed discharge dataset.

profiles.proposed_method: Analytic/integration verification first; later a vehicle-specific flight observation model.
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: No flight dataset acquired; engine test evidence is not trajectory validation.

profiles.proposed_method: Fit friction/local-loss and maldistribution response only for measured passage geometries.
profiles.observables_or_checks: located pressure differences and branch flows
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: No geometry-specific manifold measurement set acquired; cross-cutting future component contract.

profiles.proposed_method: Grey-box/state-space identification from synchronized measured histories; keep friction/backlash separate.
profiles.observables_or_checks: command, position, pressure, flow, load and bandwidth
profiles.remaining_evidence_gap: No applicable actuator time series; a combustion-instability paper does not supply valve dynamics or universal n-tau calibration.
